profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer, iOS at Tablet Hotels
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of work experience. Native mobile has been my thing since I first started building my first app. I'm mostly focused on iOS development and have also worked on Android native apps using Kotlin/Java in the past. Architecture pattern wise, I've been mostly focused on MVVM/Coordinator for iOS and MVVM/Clean Architecture for Android.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer, iOS
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Developing the Tablet and Michelin Guide flagship iOS app.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description:
• Architected and maintained rebranded flagship iOS app, utilizing MVVM/Coordinator pattern in Swift.
• Implemented and maintained partner apps for Sesame Workshop and Fisher Price.
• Built the Sesame Workshop app from the ground up using an unidirectional data flow architecture, ReSwift.
• Released the Sesame Workshop app with a 100% crash-free rate, and later 99%; a first for the company.
• Led and assisted other developers in areas I took ownership such as the Kid’s experience menu.
• Collaborated in a cross functional team to achieve continuity across both the iOS and Android apps.
• A/B Tested flagship iOS app’s onboarding screens such as payment plans to increase user engagement and conversion rates

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented the business logic for the flagship HOMER iOS app utilizing MVVM architecture in Swift.
• Pioneered the HOMER Android app by migrating from Cordova to a native experience using Kotlin and MVVM architecture.
• Thoroughly tested the business logic of the HOMER iOS and Android apps using unit, integration, and snapshot testing.
• Collaborated with product managers and designers to create a delightful mobile experience for parents and children.
• Facilitated other team members by mentoring and training them to increase their technical capabilities.
• Carried out code reviews on both Android and iOS repositories to guarantee code quality and continuity.

positions.title: Mobile Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Swift · Objective-C · Java · Kotlin · iOS Development · Android Development

positions.title: Creator
positions.description:
Successfully developed, tested and deployed app that allows the user to save information and pictures at a particular zone, and can check where they are in the map. App utilizes MapKit, Core Data, Core Animation, Core Location, Auto Resizing, Reverse Geocoding, and much more. The design of this app was made using Sketch and is currently written in Swift 3/Xcode 8.

App link: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/inmyzone/id1200453678?mt=8

positions.title: Creator
positions.description: Successfully developed, tested and deployed a colorful and fun match three emoji game app. Created test plans and Unit tests to handle edge cases, matching pairs, and more. This app utilizes SpriteKit, JSON, MVC, Core Graphics, AVFoundation and more. The design of this app was made using Sketch 3, and is currently written in Swift 3/Xcode 8.

positions.title: Sales Lead
positions.description:
■ Educated customers on available product options to meet and exceed customer service experience.
■ Learned to use Express point-of-sale and inventory systems, and helped train newer employees.
■ Investigated and resolved customer complaints or issues to strengthen store reputation and grow customer retention.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
■ Used Microsoft Excel and other software extensively by customizing customers' account's information. 
■ Provided network and desktop support by troubleshooting and managing WiFi.

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description:
■ Assisted students with hardware support by fixing equipment including peripherals.
■ Tutored students with Computer Science and Mathematical homework/projects.
■ Guided students on setting up and maintaining the network and operating systems as required.

projects.title: FireGram
projects.description: This is an Instagram clone project that utilizes Google Firebase, Login/Registration, Custom Tab Bar Controller, Image Caching, Photos framework, AVFoundation, and more. The UI is all coded programmatically and does not use storyboards. This project has been updated to Swift 4 and currently in progress.

projects.title: LocateThat
projects.description: An iTunes browser app that lets the user locate for products on the iTunes store using Split-view controller, Popovers, Landscape mode, Core Data, Core Animation, JSON Parsing, HTTP Requests, and more. This project is currently written in Swift 3 and is designed in Sketch.
